threat_event: Attacker uses a stolen engineer session to push a malicious guest-agent release through fleet automation to enrolled customer VMs and SL-3 servers
threat_source: Nation-state group or advanced criminal group targeting provider tooling
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Guest-agent channel releases need one approver from the authoring team; approvals not bound by signature; no automated halt on integrity alerts
affected_asset_or_process: SYS-08; SYS-09; enrolled customer VMs in all regions and G1; about 48,500 SL-3 servers (P05 BP-08, BP-10)
regulatory_driver: C-IT-R01 (FRC-CSF-BSL CM-3(1), SI-7(5); IEC-CSO-IIR); C-IT-R03 (252.204-7012(c)-(g), customer flow-down); C-IT-R05 (12 CFR 53.4; 225.303; 304.24); SEC Form 8-K Item 1.05
existing_controls: FIDO2 SSO; HSM signing of releases; staged rollout rings; SOC detections on release anomalies
treatment_plan: Two-person approval from separate teams for guest-agent channel releases; approver signature bound to each release; automated halt of a rollout on integrity alerts (POAM-001); P08 runbook tabletop with the disclosure committee
key_risk_indicator: Releases promoted without independent approval (target 0); time a release stays in ring 0 before wider rollout

threat_event: Attacker takes over the AQ-1 legacy RMM tool (vendor breach or technician account) and runs scripts on about 9,500 customer servers
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Legacy directory with app-based MFA; no PAM; RMM logs reach the SIEM as a daily batch; vendor contract has no security or incident notice terms
affected_asset_or_process: SYS-10; 140 SL-3 customers including banking organizations (P05 BP-09)
regulatory_driver: C-IT-R05 (12 CFR 53.4); state breach laws; SEC Form 8-K Item 1.05
existing_controls: Customer-approved maintenance windows; EDR on RMM jump hosts; contractual migration plan
treatment_plan: Move AQ-1 technicians to workforce identity and PAM; real-time RMM log streaming; vendor security addendum; migrate all AQ-1 servers to fleet automation (POAM-022)
owner: Senior Vice President, Managed Infrastructure Services
key_risk_indicator: AQ-1 servers still on the legacy RMM; RMM log latency (target under 15 minutes)

threat_event: Tenant escapes VM isolation through a hypervisor vulnerability and reaches other tenants on the same host

treatment_plan: Live-patch capability for all hypervisor releases (cuts emergency patch time to 48 hours); dedicated-host option for the G1 High workload
key_risk_indicator: Days to patch critical hypervisor flaws across 95% of hosts
